title: Compile actual monomial phases with sequential counters
body:
This replaces the retained complex monomial's decoded-address phase oracle with sequential binary counter tapes. The actual family65689/event8814 right recipe keeps its strict-upper quadratic convention, absolute tensor phase and inverse sign. One physical active-position mask supplies the geometry; no runtime width, record count or address is decoded into host control. The four-state phase codes are consumed on demand, without a complete phase table.

The [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9b1aa6b75515a2767fdab6b80eda3284bd1f5809/research/sequential-monomial-phase/PROOF.md), [producer and Gaussian consumer](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9b1aa6b75515a2767fdab6b80eda3284bd1f5809/research/sequential-monomial-phase/phase.py), [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9b1aa6b75515a2767fdab6b80eda3284bd1f5809/research/sequential-monomial-phase/RESULT.json) and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9b1aa6b75515a2767fdab6b80eda3284bd1f5809/research/sequential-monomial-phase/SOURCES.json) define the scope. For fixed recipe dimension m, equal field width b and R=2^(mb) records, the complete phase bill is at most `32(m+1)(R+b+1)` reads, writes and unit moves. It includes counter initialization, every carry and cleanup. The retained coefficient loop adds exactly `18V` source tape actions for V payload bits. Counter backing, output and coefficient scratch remain charged.

The complete kappa calculation is unchanged. The supplied mask's manufacture, arbitrary mixed-width packing, affine routing, recursive C, physical allocation, full wrapper stock/precision, native admission and outer recovery remain open. The demonstrated consumer has one Gaussian coefficient per record and consumes its owned input. A caller needing input preservation must pay for a copy. Integer interpretation retains the source headroom condition; the bit checks use exact modular encodings. The inverse phase applies after affine coordinate recovery. No full 147-bit production payload is claimed.

Validation on CPython 3.12.13, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/sequential-monomial-phase
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/sequential-monomial-phase
```

Both registered isolated, warning-strict normal and optimized commands pass `PASS_SEQUENTIAL_MONOMIAL_PHASE`. Evidence includes 224 generic complete domains with 9760 records; 524800 actual source phase records, including the full two-column rectangle and a full inactive-bit rectangle; six 1024-record Gaussian payload cases in both directions; exact coefficient-meter agreement; and six rejecting ABI controls. Each source payload case adds 120506 physical phase actions, independent of dirty ancestor lengths 16,257,4096. Four disposable mutations reject in both modes before receipt comparison. Committed bytes, official export integrity and both read-only Git-free export commands pass; all 16 exported files remain unchanged.

Base is canonical main `7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56`, priority 7, refreshed before submission. Every source pin is on that base. The full-history wrapper, selected cold replay, native transition-table compiler, full production controller, Lean and Docker were not run. Hosted CI and independent human/proof-kernel acceptance remain separate.

Credit @jmbarrancoml for [PR #2250](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2250)'s [monomial and coefficient source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56/research/selected-complex-compact-adapters/monomial.py); @JoyboyBrian for [PR #5329](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5329)'s [retained actual recipe](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56/research/complex-segment-boundary/RIGHT-RECIPE.json); Cinna Davis for cached chirp production; and Ryanson Jonathan for [PR #4325](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4325)'s [odometer tariff audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56/research/pr4100-chirp-odometer-tariff/README.md). Counter amortization, the phase identity and unit-phase arithmetic are credited methods. The new result is the source-specific finite-symbol producer and its actual coefficient binding. Native/Clifford authors and original notices retain their credit.

Overlap covers the live packet handoff, targeted all-state phase/counter PR searches, relevant canonical-main notes, and a refreshed public snapshot of 322 open PRs and 4657 Discussion records with complete pagination. Sparse local-note omissions, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain outside coverage. Only this package is added. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, implementation, review and verification. Apache-2.0.
